description.value: Stega Eatery is a restaurant located in Vancouver's Olympic Village neighbourhood on Columbia Street, a popular cycling corridor near the False Creek seawall. The OSM record notes indoor seating and a smoke-free environment. Its location in one of Vancouver's most cycle-friendly districts makes it a natural stop for riders exploring the seawall or commuting through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 10m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 29m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 41m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 78m. Total: 32 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content retrieved for stegaeatery.ca is entirely a cookie consent/privacy banner with no actual business information visible, so OSM tags are the sole evidence source for all amenity fields. OSM confirms a restaurant at 1778 Columbia Street in Vancouver's Olympic Village area with indoor seating and no outdoor seating. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned in either source, so those fields are null.
concerns: Website content retrieved as only a cookie consent/privacy banner — no substantive business information (menu, amenities, contact details) was visible. Most amenity fields cannot be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open restaurant in a high-cycling-traffic area of Vancouver; OSM shows no signs of closure and the business appears active.
